name: autocomplete-paths
author: lumine-code
description: Complete file paths from cached project contents.
backgroundTips: Refresh project path suggestions with the autocomplete-paths cache rebuild command

normalizeSlashes.title: Normalize Slashes
normalizeSlashes.description: Use forward slashes in inserted paths on every platform.

maxFileCount.title: Maximum Files
maxFileCount.description: Maximum number of files cached for each project root.

suggestionPriority.title: Suggestion Priority
suggestionPriority.description: Priority reported to the autocomplete service.

followSymlinks.title: Follow Symbolic Links
followSymlinks.description: Follow directory links while scanning project roots.

imagePreview.title: Image Previews
imagePreview.description: Display image thumbnails in path suggestions.

ignoredNames.title: Use Core Ignored Names
ignoredNames.description: Exclude entries matched by the core ignored-names setting.

ignoreSubmodules.title: Ignore Submodules
ignoreSubmodules.description: Exclude paths reported as repository submodules.

ignoredPatterns.title: Additional Ignored Patterns
ignoredPatterns.description: Glob patterns excluded from path suggestions.

scopes.title: Custom Scopes
scopes.description: Additional scope, prefix, extension, and replacement definitions.

enableHtmlSupport.title: HTML Attribute Support
enableHtmlSupport.description: Suggest paths inside common HTML path attributes.
